candidate.title: RRMAB-seq
candidate.scope: The assigned RRMAB-seq row: reduced-representation M.SssI methylase-assisted bisulfite sequencing of genomic DNA, including its untreated Control and M.SssI branches. The nearby MAB-seq, TAB-Seq and partial fCAB-seq rows and right-hand chemical structure are context, not additional target workflows. MAB-seq is a named assay principle within the reduced-representation implementation, not an additional target. The endpoint is amplified DNA encoding cytosine-conversion outcomes; sequencing and computational combination are not drawn.

operations.label: Digest with MspI
operations.description: Cleaves genomic DNA into the fragment substrate used for the reduced-representation library.
operations.mechanism: MspI recognizes and cuts CCGG, as stated by the matched secondary catalogue page.
operations.information_effect: Restricts the represented genomic material toward CpG-rich regions such as promoters rather than supplying uniform whole-genome representation.

operations.label: Control / M.SssI
operations.description: Retains the two explicitly drawn processing routes from the same prepared DNA substrate: an untreated control and a route receiving M.SssI. This represents branch allocation without asserting an unshown aliquoting procedure.
operations.information_effect: Maintains comparable preparation history while distinguishing absence or presence of methylase treatment; no pooling or joint chemical reaction is drawn.

evidence.locator: RRMAB-seq row: arrows to Control and M.SssI branches

operations.label: M.SssI
operations.description: Converts the unmodified illustrated cytosine to methylated cytosine in the treated route; the other illustrated modified cytosine classes remain as drawn.
operations.mechanism: Depicted: M.SssI converts the illustrated C to 5mC. The primary implementation also methylates before MspI; its later methylation protects end-repair-derived cytosines (c_methylation_order).
operations.information_effect: Protects originally unmodified CpG C from contributing a T signal in the depicted bisulfite/PCR endpoint. Non-CpG unmodified C is a specificity limitation of the method.
